title: version
description: Which contract versions an app reads and writes, in the one version answer every app gives, in every contract version from version/v2 on (ADR-S03, ADR-S16): a reader that was told unsupported_contract, or that meets an app for the first time, asks it and then asks again with a version both speak, one the app reads for a read and one it writes for a write. The app, its build and the contract this answer is in are read from source. It never refuses a contract: source.contract is the asked version when the app reads it, otherwise the newest it reads. It is on envelope/v3; version/v1 stays on envelope/v1 for readers that ask for it.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/contracts/version/v2: the one form of this version answer, the same for every app and every contract version, so a reader knows its shape whatever it asked for.

kind.description: Always Version, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

data.description: Which contract versions the app reads and writes; which app, which build and which contract this answer is in are in source, never here.

reads.description: Every contract version the app answers a read in: its own and each older one its down steps reach, on envelope/v3 or later (ADR-S16). An answer in an older version than its own says so with the problem converted_down. It includes source.contract; each app's tests check that.

items.description: One contract version, such as v2.

writes.description: Every contract version the app takes a write in: its own and the one before, whose writes it steps up, keeping the fields the older form cannot hold (ADR-S16). A write in any other version gets unsupported_contract. Each one is also in reads; each app's tests check that.

items.description: One contract version, such as v3.
